techs.name: Lily Lancets
techs.notes: 3 lancets (6 with the cat). Each refracted lancet shaves 1; +2 when it lands in the colour the plate is showing. At Boost Lv3: 370%, +25% AoE, +1 shave.

techs.name: Cathedral Ray
techs.notes: White light that picks up a pane's tag: Azure [ICE], Amber [FIRE], Cobalt [TACHYON] (the prism split, 9.4).

techs.name: Prism Discharge
techs.notes: Cost 5 MP + Light Stacks. Releases stored Light Stacks as beams (+1 beam per stack spent) and leaves a caustic floor. +35% while the cat is fully inside his chest. Any light source on the plane fractures. Along a tether: prism split.

techs.name: Prism Refraction
techs.notes: Needs no stacks. 6 prisms (9 at Lv3). Lv3 leaves a caustic floor that refracts FERRO shards (they gain [VITREOUS]). Double damage vs the Glass Matriarch.

techs.name: Baptistery
techs.notes: 1.0 total over 2 hits. The baptistery's frozen splash thaws: allies inside regain 10% HP.

techs.name: Rose Window
techs.notes: Cast at Boost Lv3 or higher. The Rose overhead, Schala's full portrait: for 8 s every party attack is VITREOUS (keeping its other tags) and gains one extra hit from a random angle. Leaves a residual puddle.

techs.name: Fractured Lens
techs.notes: Debt move: Vesper to 1 HP, Fragile 2 turns. Below 25% HP: instantly fills 5 Light Stacks and reveals the library. Its first use reads 'Crono Vaporization - Original Account'.

techs.name: Prism Guard
techs.notes: Command from 10.6, not a 11.7 row: until his next turn -40% damage taken, +1 Light Stack per hit taken, +2 with the cat overlapping. Free.
